scope: bounded repository-owned unsigned DSSE/in-toto envelope construction and decoding
requirements: non-string predicate types and subjects fail with controlled AttestationError values
non-object predicates and envelopes fail with controlled AttestationError values
non-string or malformed payloads fail with controlled AttestationError values
decoded statements are subject to the same subject, predicate type and predicate object checks
signature entries are objects with string keyid (including keyless empty keyid) and valid base64 sig fields
builder and decoder apply the same strict statement-field validation
nonclaims: Unsigned envelope validation is not cryptographic verification or release approval.
